name: Vertical Stretching
problem:
Multiplying an exponential growth function by a positive number **scales** the graph in the vertical direction.

For example, the curve ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/68dcb337cb0927d43403eebeb21c0a54dc46a136f7cd21ce821d9bfc325c748e.svg) represents a vertical scaling of ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/763bdfd3547d86e0c619eb55c57d6d3b83c3405c6fa04c01f4405a056475e9cf.svg) by a factor of ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/270d33581e0657a10d567c6cfaa529521b34e20a39c9a29550698cbf252fabfa.svg)  It takes all of the ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/1d9b846cface9f9348e4081a0dd87dd254bf26663c12aa0d1a15aa24d2393261.svg)-coordinates on ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/763bdfd3547d86e0c619eb55c57d6d3b83c3405c6fa04c01f4405a056475e9cf.svg) and multiplies them by ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14194531/assets/270d33581e0657a10d567c6cfaa529521b34e20a39c9a29550698cbf252fabfa.svg) This has the effect of **stretching** the curve upwards.
